mapper.sql: select distinct bm_weigh_requirement.id as id, bm_product_formula_material.id as formula_material_id, bm_product_formula_material.material_name, bm_product_formula_material.material_merge_code, bm_product_formula_material.material_specification, bm_weigh_centre.name as weigh_centre_name, bm_weigh_requirement.requirement_date, bm_weigh_requirement.requirement_quantity, bm_product_formula_material.unit_id, bm_product_plan.product_name, bm_product_plan.product_merge_code, bm_product_plan.process_name, bm_product_plan.batch_no from bm_weigh_requirement left join bm_product_formula_material on bm_weigh_requirement.formula_material_id = bm_product_formula_material.id and bm_product_formula_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_weigh_centre on bm_weigh_requirement.weigh_centre_id = bm_weigh_centre.id and bm_weigh_centre.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_product_plan on bm_weigh_requirement.product_plan_id = bm_product_plan.id and bm_product_plan.is_deleted = 0

select bm_weigh_requirement.id, bm_weigh_requirement.formula_material_id, bm_product_formula_material.material_id, bm_product_formula_material.unit_id as formula_unit_id, bm_weigh_requirement.weigh_centre_id, bm_weigh_requirement.requirement_date, bm_weigh_requirement.requirement_quantity, bm_weigh_requirement.product_plan_id, bm_weigh_requirement.requirement_status from bm_weigh_requirement left join bm_product_formula_material on bm_weigh_requirement.formula_material_id = bm_product_formula_material.id and bm_product_formula_material.is_deleted = 0
bm_weigh_requirement.is_deleted = 0
and bm_weigh_requirement.id in
#{requirementId}
order by bm_weigh_requirement.id desc

select bm_weigh_requirement.id, bm_product_formula_material.material_id, bm_weigh_requirement.formula_material_id, bm_product_formula_material.material_name, bm_product_formula_material.material_merge_code, bm_product_formula_material.material_type as category_type, bm_storage_material_batch.id as storage_material_batch_id, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no as storage_material_batch_no, bm_weigh_requirement.product_plan_id, bm_weigh_requirement.batch_no, bm_weigh_requirement.product_name, bm_weigh_requirement.requirement_quantity as target_total_quantity, bm_weigh_requirement.unit_id, bm_weigh_requirement.weigh_process, bm_weigh_requirement.weigher_id, bm_weigh_task.id as task_id from bm_weigh_requirement left join bm_product_formula_material on bm_weigh_requirement.formula_material_id = bm_product_formula_material.id and bm_product_formula_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_storage_material_batch on bm_weigh_requirement.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id and bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_weigh_task on bm_weigh_requirement.weigh_requirement_task_id = bm_weigh_task.id and bm_weigh_task.is_deleted = 0 where bm_weigh_requirement.is_deleted = 0 and bm_weigh_requirement.id = #{requirementId}

select bm_weigh_requirement.id, bm_weigh_requirement.product_plan_id, bm_weigh_requirement.requirement_quantity, bm_weigh_requirement.unit_id, bm_product_plan.product_name, bm_product_plan.product_merge_code, bm_weigh_requirement.batch_no, bm_product_plan.process_name, bm_weigh_requirement.weigh_status, bm_weigh_requirement.requirement_status, bm_weigh_requirement.expired_date, bm_weigh_requirement.storage_material_batch_id, bm_weigh_requirement.weigh_process from bm_weigh_requirement left join bm_product_plan on bm_product_plan.id = bm_weigh_requirement.product_plan_id and bm_product_plan.is_deleted = 0 where bm_weigh_requirement.is_deleted = 0 and bm_weigh_requirement.weigh_requirement_task_id = #{taskId}
